metadata.description: nunchi notices what's off in every corner of your web app (preview).

plugins.name: nunchi
plugins.description: Preview: captures every screen and state of your web app (phone and desktop, empty, error, slow, offline), finds UI defects with evidence, double-checks the AI findings, shows them on a live local board where you decide, and fixes what you decided on a branch, keeping a fix only when a re-capture shows the defect gone.
